mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP2C9 and glucuronidation pathways, reducing valproate levels by 25-40%, while valproate inhibits phenobarbital metabolism, increasing phenobarbital levels and CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor valproate and phenobarbital levels closely; consider alternative anticonvulsants or adjust doses based on therapeutic drug monitoring; assess for increased phenobarbital toxicity signs.
